purpose_zh: 六项空间审计型读数的定义、方法与责任方。全部读数不依赖参与者招募，由审计人员以卷尺、秒表、照度计与检查表现场产出——JZ-01 通用可达底线审计开工当天即可产出第一批数字。本文件只登记定义，不含任何数值；六项读数均不进入七项包容性指标口径，不与其共用分母，也不构成对其中任何一项的替代。
purpose_en: Definitions, methods and owners for six spatial audit readings. None depends on participant recruitment: auditors produce them with tape, stopwatch, lux meter and checklist — the first numbers can exist on day one of the JZ-01 universal-access baseline audit. This file registers definitions only and holds no value; none of the six enters the seven inclusion-metric definitions, shares their denominators, or substitutes for any of them.
discipline_zh: 数值产出后按「分母不得删除失败样本」同源纪律登记：不可测点位与测量失败原因必须与成功测量一并报告。全部读数为现场实测口径，与图版的概念口径（半径、示意比例）互不换算。
discipline_en: Once values exist they follow the same denominator discipline: unmeasurable points and failed measurements are reported alongside successes. All readings are field-measured and never converted against the figures' conceptual calibers (radii, indicative scales).

readings.definition_zh: 同一节点对之间，轮椅可行路径实测长度 ÷ 无障碍要求外的最短步行路径实测长度。
readings.definition_en: Between one node pair: measured wheelchair-passable route length over the measured shortest walking route without the accessibility requirement.
readings.method_zh: 测距轮沿两条路径实走；每对记录路径轨迹、日期与不可通行原因。
readings.method_en: Walk both routes with a measuring wheel; record trace, date and any impassable cause per pair.
readings.owner_role_zh: 无障碍与交通审计人员

readings.definition_zh: 三处横向接口处，行人一个完整信号周期内的最大等待时长；无信号处记实测可穿越间隙的最大等待。
readings.definition_en: At the three lateral interfaces: the maximum pedestrian wait within one full signal cycle, or, unsignalised, the maximum wait for a crossable gap.
readings.method_zh: 秒表连续记录不少于十个周期，取最大值与中位数一并登记。
readings.method_en: Stopwatch at least ten consecutive cycles; register both the maximum and the median.

readings.definition_zh: 降雨条件下沿主脊与横向接口新增的不可通行断点数（积水、湿滑、排水口阻挡轮椅）。
readings.definition_en: New impassable breaks along the spine and interfaces under rain (ponding, slip surfaces, drainage grates blocking wheels).
readings.method_zh: 雨天复走晴天基线路径，逐断点拍照定位登记。
readings.method_en: Re-walk the fair-weather baseline in rain; photograph and locate every break.
readings.owner_role_zh: 场地运营与无障碍审计人员

readings.definition_zh: 夜间沿同一路径因照明不足、导视不可读或声环境失序新增的断点数；照度以照度计实测登记。
readings.definition_en: New breaks along the same routes at night from insufficient lighting, illegible wayfinding or disordered acoustics; illuminance metered and registered.
readings.method_zh: 日落后两小时内复走基线路径，断点处记照度值与断点类型。
readings.method_en: Re-walk within two hours after sunset; log illuminance and break type at each break.
readings.owner_role_zh: 照明与场地运营审计人员

readings.definition_zh: 触觉引导带每公里中断点数；中断 = 缺失、错位、被占压或与检查井盖冲突任一情形。
readings.definition_en: Interruptions per kilometre of tactile guidance band; an interruption is any gap, misalignment, obstruction or manhole conflict.
readings.method_zh: 全线逐段目测加白杖实探，中断点逐一定位登记。
readings.method_en: Segment-by-segment visual plus cane probing along the full band; every interruption located and registered.
readings.owner_role_zh: 无障碍审计人员（含白杖使用者视角复核）

readings.definition_zh: 铸刻导视与固定信息版在其设计视距处的可读率：可读样本数 ÷ 抽检样本数；夜间与雨天各复测一轮。
readings.definition_en: Share of engraved wayfinding and fixed information panels legible at their design viewing distance: legible samples over sampled panels; re-tested once at night and once in rain.
readings.method_zh: 按设计视距立点抽检，眩光、遮挡、污损逐项记因。
readings.method_en: Spot-check at the design distance; glare, obstruction and soiling each logged as causes.
readings.owner_role_zh: 导视与无障碍审计人员

note_zh: 六项读数的首批数值将随 JZ-01 审计报告登记，登记时须附测量日期、天气、工具与不可测点位清单。
note_en: First values register with the JZ-01 audit report, carrying date, weather, tools and the list of unmeasurable points.
